ARCHITECTURAL SEPARATION

HERO separates retrieval from insertion scoring

Two jobs, two selectors
HNSW narrows which insertion positions deserve attention; a scalar objective chooses among feasible candidates.
DESTROY
ALNS removes a subset of customers from the current solution.
ENCODE
Each candidate insertion position becomes a feature vector.
RETRIEVE
HNSW returns a short list of likely useful positions.
SELECT
Exact feasibility checks and scalar scoring determine the accepted insertion.
